style_pack_rationale: The story is a first-person founder reflection about turning repeated support pain into roadmap focus.

secondary_influence.compatibility_note: Use only its workflow clarity; avoid feature-heavy demo pacing.

tts_delivery: Grounded founder reflection with calm confidence, opening with focused urgency and closing on practical resolve.
global_visual_style: Documentary-realistic founder workspace, soft daylight, close hands, anonymized support cards, and clean roadmap sketches with no readable UI text.
visual_strategy: Follow one consistent workspace and show the shift from scattered support noise to grouped patterns and a focused roadmap.
global_pacing: Four steady beats: immediate hook, support overload, pattern recognition, and practical lesson.
energy_curve: Medium at the hook, medium-low during overwhelm, medium during the turn, and calm medium at the close.
global_music_direction: Warm minimal piano with a soft pulse that becomes slightly clearer after the pattern recognition turn.

avoid: text inside generated images except renderer-managed scene 1 title metadata
readable customer tickets or product UI
revenue, growth, or proprietary roadmap claims

visual_contract.style_summary: Founder workspace realism with anonymized work artifacts and restrained camera movement.
continuity_rules: Keep the same desk, light quality, and color palette across scenes.
Represent tickets as unreadable abstract cards.
Use hands, notes, and roadmap shapes instead of legible interfaces.
visual_contract.text_policy: Generated visuals must be text-free; all labels, tickets, UI, and notes stay blurred or abstract.
visual_contract.face_image_guidance: Scene 1 may carry only renderer-managed title metadata, not generated text in the image.
visual_contract.visual_prompt_boundary: Downstream prompt builders create production prompts; this contract only sets intent and constraints.

voice_contract.delivery_summary: Measured voiceover that feels like a founder explaining a lesson after the fact.
voice_contract.scene_delivery_policy: Each scene should preserve the spoken line and match its emotional beat without adding words.
voice_contract.clean_script_boundary: Do not add provider tags or rewrite the narration script.

music_sfx_contract.music_direction: Warm minimal piano or soft pulse under narration, lifting slightly when the pattern becomes clear.
music_sfx_contract.sfx_direction: Sparse desk, paper, soft keyboard, or subtle notification textures only.
music_sfx_contract.license_note: Music and SFX require known usage rights before publish.

caption_contract.caption_angle: A practical founder habit: repeated support pain can reveal roadmap priorities.
caption_contract.cta_guidance: Invite saving or reviewing before the next roadmap meeting.
caption_contract.hashtag_guidance: Use founder, startup, product, customer feedback, and roadmap tags later; do not rank here.
copy_constraints: Do not include hashtags in the contract.
Do not claim real customer data or measurable business results.
Keep the caption practical and non-hype.

edit_contract.pacing_summary: Keep scene 1 short, then let scenes 2-4 breathe around one idea each.
edit_contract.transition_language: Use simple cuts, match cuts, and one soft push-in around the pattern recognition turn.
render_handoff_notes: Keep vertical 9:16 framing clean and mobile readable.
Subtitle burn-in remains disabled unless a later render contract changes it.
Scene 1 title belongs to renderer metadata, not generated image text.

avatar_contract.avatar_policy: No avatar is needed; use workspace and hands-first visuals.
avatar_contract.consent_boundary: Do not imply a real founder likeness or customer identity without explicit consent metadata.

routing_hints.image_video_policy: Scene 1 is an image/title-card background; later scenes should use motion-friendly video beats.
routing_hints.provider_selection_policy: Leave final provider, model, host, and render selection to downstream adapters.
handoff_notes: Prioritize text-free visuals with clear focal action.
Pass consent and customer-data risks into asset review.
Preserve the selected style pack as creative guidance only.

risk_flags.description: The support-ticket concept could lead to visible private customer information.
risk_flags.mitigation: Use unreadable cards, abstract notes, and generic workspace visuals.

risk_flags.description: Music direction is useful but no licensed track is selected at this stage.

qa_focus: No readable ticket, UI, note, logo, or customer data appears in visuals.
No revenue, traction, or real-customer claim is implied.
Scene 1 title is renderer metadata only.
Music usage rights are known before publish.

scenes.scene_objective: Hook the viewer with the idea that roadmap clarity came from repeated support pain.
scenes.tts_instructions: (curious) (confident) Open with measured intrigue; let the repeated complaint idea land.
scenes.visual_strategy: Use a clean founder desk with unreadable notes and a single clear focal subject.
scenes.transition_hint: Hard cut into the support overload beat.
scenes.music_sfx_cue: Single warm piano note with a soft pulse entering.
scenes.caption_intent: Set up the practical lesson without overexplaining.
qa_focus: No generated title text in the image.

scenes.scene_objective: Show support work feeling distracting before patterns become visible.
scenes.tts_instructions: (worried) Keep the read reflective, not frantic.
scenes.visual_strategy: Show abstract support-card volume and desk clutter without readable ticket content.
scenes.transition_hint: Match cut from scattered cards to grouped cards.
scenes.music_sfx_cue: Soft ticking rhythm under the piano bed.
scenes.caption_intent: Reinforce that repeated pain beats isolated requests.
qa_focus: No private or proprietary data is visible.

scenes.scene_objective: Make the pattern recognition turn clear.
scenes.tts_instructions: (determined) Slightly emphasize the repeated pain turning into a decision.
scenes.visual_strategy: Use hands grouping color-coded notes and a clear physical pattern without text.
scenes.transition_hint: Subtle push-in as notes form one cluster.
scenes.music_sfx_cue: Pulse becomes more confident but stays under narration.
scenes.caption_intent: Connect support patterns to roadmap focus.

scenes.scene_objective: Close with the lesson that support can reveal priorities.
scenes.tts_instructions: (calm) (confident) Use a clean closing cadence with practical confidence.
scenes.visual_strategy: Show a clean roadmap board made of abstract shapes and calm daylight continuity.
scenes.music_sfx_cue: Gentle resolution with no dramatic hit.
scenes.caption_intent: Invite the viewer to save the lesson for planning.
